report_title: Demo Company May Operating Review | Meeting Readiness Report

meeting_context.meeting_goal: Assess May performance and decide the June acquisition budget

summary.executive_summary: Revenue grew, but the deck overstates gross margin and does not resolve the trade-off between acquisition scale and customer quality.

findings.title: Gross margin claim uses the prior-month value
findings.assessment: The source workbook reports May gross margin at 42%; 46% is the April value.
findings.recommended_fix: Change the May gross-margin statement to 42% and explain the four-point decline before discussing further acquisition spend.

findings.title: The recommendation does not address customer-quality decline
findings.assessment: Ad spend rose from 20,000 to 28,000 while paid D1 retention fell from 31% to 26%; the recommendation lacks a quality guardrail.

evidence.value_or_quote: Paid D1 retention 31% to 26%; ad spend 20,000 to 28,000

findings.recommended_fix: Define a retention threshold and channel-level test before approving another budget increase.

questions.question: Why should we increase acquisition spend when gross margin and paid-user retention both declined?
questions.why_it_may_be_asked: The proposal asks for more budget without proving that the acquired growth is profitable or durable.
questions.direct_answer: The current evidence does not support an unconditional 20% increase. A smaller channel-level test with a 30% D1 retention guardrail should come first.

evidence.value_or_quote: Gross margin 46% to 42%; paid D1 retention 31% to 26%; ad spend 20,000 to 28,000

unknowns: Channel-level retention and margin are not available
questions.next_question: Which channel should receive the test budget, and what result would stop the test?

simulation.title: Demo rehearsal | CEO + Finance + Growth
simulation.opening: Answer in your own words first, then compare against the evidence-grounded answer.

rounds.question: Is May's growth actually healthy?
rounds.intent: Test whether the owner recognizes the quality trade-off.
rounds.suggested_answer: Revenue grew 12%, but gross margin fell to 42% and paid D1 retention fell to 26%, so I would describe the growth as real but lower quality.

evidence.value_or_quote: Revenue 100,000 to 112,000; margin 46% to 42%; retention 31% to 26%

rounds.prep_action: Add channel-level margin and retention before the meeting.
rounds.follow_up_question: Which part of the growth would you keep if budget were fixed?
rounds.avoid_answer: Revenue is up, so the strategy is working.

rounds.question: What is the profit impact of the four-point margin decline?
rounds.intent: Translate a percentage change into a decision-relevant amount.
rounds.suggested_answer: The deck does not yet include a validated profit bridge, so I cannot give a reliable amount today.
unknowns: Refunds, variable fulfillment cost, and channel mix
rounds.prep_action: Prepare a gross-profit bridge using validated revenue and variable-cost data.
rounds.follow_up_question: When will the bridge be ready, and who owns it?

rounds.question: Which acquisition segment caused retention to fall?
rounds.intent: Check whether the proposed response targets the actual cause.
rounds.suggested_answer: The current workbook only provides the total paid-user metric, so it cannot identify a responsible channel or segment.
rounds.prep_action: Export channel and audience-segment cohorts for April and May.
rounds.follow_up_question: What minimum cohort size will you require before reallocating budget?
rounds.avoid_answer: The new audience was probably lower quality.

rounds.question: What decision are you asking us to make today?
rounds.intent: Force a bounded, evidence-aware budget proposal.
rounds.suggested_answer: Approve only a limited acquisition test, contingent on a 30% paid D1 retention threshold and a reviewed channel-level margin estimate.
rounds.prep_action: The CEO and finance lead must agree on the test cap and stop conditions.
rounds.follow_up_question: What happens if the test misses the retention threshold?
rounds.avoid_answer: Approve 20% more spend and we will optimize along the way.

data_requests.item: Channel-level contribution margin and paid D1 retention
data_requests.reason: Required to evaluate whether another acquisition test is profitable and durable.
data_requests.deadline: One business day before the meeting
